data.action: 坐在断墙上，头盔搁在膝边
data.description: 【泥岩 · 废墟小憩】被夕阳染红的残破石堡废墟顶端，脱下厚重全覆式头盔的泥岩将头盔搁在膝边，一头如瀑布般的银白色长发在晚风中散落开来。她碧蓝色的眼眸中满是宁静——「战场上的废墟虽然荒凉……但只要头顶还有天空，泥土里就依然会蕴藏着新生的希望。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock sits on the ruined fortress wall with her reinforced helmet resting beside one knee, silver-white hair moving in the evening wind. Ivory cable-knit turtleneck, open dark-camel wool coat and cashmere scarf retain her winter outfit. The medium view includes fractured wall stones supporting the seat and the red-lit ruins behind. Amber dusk illuminates sweater ribs and hair edges, casting darker stone shadows beneath the coat's softly shaded folds.
data.title: 泥岩 · 废墟小憩
